en.title: Automated Team Roster Synchronization
en.excerpt: How the auto-sync engine aggregates top qualification scores to rank and seed official club teams.
en.content:
The Auto-Sync Algorithm

Following qualification finalization, the Auto-Sync Teams feature scans all individual score totals and automatically selects the highest-scoring archers from each club to form official competition rosters.

Executing Team Synchronization

To synchronize team rosters:

  1. Go to Tournament Dashboard > Teams & Beregu.
  2. Select the team category (e.g., Recurve Men Team 70m).
  3. Click Sync Teams (Auto-Sync).
  4. The system generates official team rosters complete with total qualification scores.

Cumulative Team Score Calculation

Team qualification score is calculated as: Athlete 1 Score + Athlete 2 Score + Athlete 3 Score = Total Team Score. This total determines team seeding on the elimination bracket.

Automated Mixed Team Pairings

For Mixed Team events, the algorithm pairs the highest-ranking male archer and the highest-ranking female archer from each respective club.
